text: Yes, native forest was deforested on this property in 2022. A 0.6-hectare area of tree-cover loss was detected in 2022, of which 0.5 hectares was confirmed as native forest by Uruguay’s official forest map (MGAP 2021). The remaining 0.1 hectares had no forest cover in 2020. While 0.2 hectares of loss occurred in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares (excluded from reporting), the event met the criteria of being observed in later years and corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference data. This represents 3.41% of the total asset area.
